verdict.rationale: Firebase exposes a well-documented CLI and SDKs, plus an official MCP server that verified hands-on to start locally and respond to JSON-RPC handshakes, letting AI agents manage Firestore, Auth, and projects programmatically. While a formal OpenAPI/swagger spec and llms.txt were not found (404s), the combination of CLI, Admin SDKs, and native MCP support gives AI-native users a solid, documented way to drive the product.
